titleEn: Poly-B Pipe Replacement Vancouver 2026 - Costs, Insurance & BC Permits
titleZh: 温哥华 Poly-B 管道更换 2026 - 费用、保险与 BC 许可
excerptEn: Poly-B plumbing fails silently — then suddenly floods your home. In Vancouver, insurers are dropping renewals on Poly-B properties. Here is what replacement actually costs in 2026, who it affects, and what Reno Stars does about it.
excerptZh: Poly-B 管道悄然老化，然后突然爆裂漏水。在温哥华，保险公司正拒绝续保配备 Poly-B 管道的房屋。以下是 2026 年更换管道的实际费用、影响范围，以及 Reno Stars 的应对方案。
contentEn:
Homes built in Vancouver between 1985 and 1997 likely contain Poly-B (polybutylene) plumbing — gray or white plastic pipes stamped PB2110 that run from the main shutoff to every tap, toilet, and appliance. The chlorine in Metro Vancouver water reacts with the pipe walls, causing brittleness, micro-cracks, and sudden leaks. As of 2025, multiple BC insurers will not renew home insurance on Poly-B properties. Replacement is no longer optional maintenance: it is a transactional necessity. Reno Stars replaces Poly-B with PEX (cross-linked polyethylene) across Metro Vancouver, handles the BC building permit and pressure inspection, and provides the completion certificate your insurer requires.

Poly-B plumbing failures account for a significant share of residential water damage claims in Metro Vancouver. Unlike a slow drip, a Poly-B burst can release thousands of litres of water in hours, destroying drywall, flooring, and contents before the main shutoff is reached. The failure is unpredictable — pipes can look intact externally while the interior wall has degraded to the point of rupture. Reno Stars has replaced Poly-B systems in Richmond, Burnaby, Vancouver, Coquitlam, Surrey, North Vancouver, and Delta homes.

How Much Does Poly-B Replacement Cost in Vancouver in 2026?

Replacement cost depends on property size and layout. Condos range from $4,000-$12,000 depending on bathrooms and floor plan. Townhouses typically cost $8,000-$14,000. A single-family home (1,500-2,500 sq ft, two floors) runs $10,000-$16,000. Luxury single-family homes with three floors and multiple ensuites run $20,000-$35,000+. All prices include BC building permit, pressure test certificate, and PEX re-pipe of all hot and cold supply lines from the manifold to every fixture. Paint touch-up is quoted separately.

Planning a kitchen, bathroom, whole-home or commercial renovation? Get a free, no-obligation quote from Reno Stars.

Does Poly-B Affect BC Home Insurance?

Directly. Several major BC insurers have updated their underwriting guidelines to decline or limit coverage on properties with Poly-B plumbing. After a certified PEX replacement with a pressure test certificate, most insurers restore standard coverage at standard rates. BC brokers report annual premium savings of $800-$1,500 after replacement — effectively recovering 5-10% of the replacement cost per year.

The BC insurance market remains firm on Poly-B. Replacing now means standard coverage at standard rates, removes buyer objections at resale, and eliminates the risk of a catastrophic leak at the worst possible moment.

How Long Does Poly-B Replacement Take?

Condo (single level, one bathroom): 2-3 days. Townhouse (two levels): 4-6 days. Single-family home (two levels, 1,500-2,500 sq ft): 5-7 days. Luxury single-family home (three levels, multiple ensuites): 10-14 days. BC permit processing in Metro Vancouver currently runs 1-3 weeks.

How to Tell If Your Home Has Poly-B

Poly-B is gray or white plastic pipe marked PB2110, Shell, or Qest. If your Metro Vancouver home was built between 1985 and 1997 and has never had a full plumbing replacement, assume Poly-B until a licensed plumber confirms otherwise. Ask for a Poly-B assessment when you book your free Reno Stars consultation.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does BC home insurance cover Poly-B replacement?

BC insurers generally do not cover preventive Poly-B replacement. But after a certified PEX replacement with a pressure test certificate, most insurers restore standard coverage at standard rates. If water damage has already occurred from a Poly-B leak, claims may be partially or fully denied.

Can I sell a home with Poly-B pipes in BC?

BC requires sellers to disclose the presence of Poly-B plumbing. Buyers frequently use this as a negotiating lever to reduce the sale price by $10,000-$25,000. Completing a PEX replacement before listing removes this objection entirely.

What is PEX pipe and why is it the standard for replacement?

PEX (cross-linked polyethylene) is the current Canadian standard for residential plumbing, CSA B137.5 certified and approved in all BC municipalities. Manufacturers provide 25-50 year warranties.

Can I do a partial Poly-B repair instead of full replacement?

A partial repair does not address the systemic degradation of the rest of the system. Insurers will not restore coverage on partially repaired Poly-B systems.

Does Reno Stars handle strata properties and condo board replacements?

Yes. Reno Stars works with strata management companies to plan and coordinate building-wide Poly-B replacement projects, which can reduce per-unit costs by 15-25%.
contentZh:
1985 年至 1997 年间建于温哥华的房屋很可能装有 Poly-B（聚丁烯）管道——灰白色塑料管，标注PB2110，从主阀一直延伸到每个水龙头、马桶和电器。Metro Vancouver 水中所含的氯会与管道内壁发生反应，导致脆化、微裂纹和突然漏水。截至 2025 年，多家 BC 保险公司已拒绝为配备 Poly-B 管道的房屋续保。更换管道不再是可选项，而是交易的必要条件。Reno Stars 在整个大温地区将 Poly-B 更换为 PEX（交联聚乙烯）管，负责办理 BC 建筑许可、压力测试验收，并提供保险公司要求的完工证明。

Poly-B 管道故障占大温哥华地区住宅水损索赔的很大比例。与缓慢滴漏不同，Poly-B 爆裂可能在数小时内释放数千升水。Reno Stars 已在列治文、本拿比、温哥华、高贵林、素里、北温哥华和三角洲的房屋中完成了 Poly-B 更换。

2026 年温哥华 Poly-B 更换费用是多少？

更换费用取决于房屋面积和布局。公寓从 $4,000 至 $12,000 不等，联排别墅通常为 $8,000 至 $14,000。两层独立屋（1,500-2,500 平方英尺）约 $10,000 至 $16,000。三层多套间豪华独立屋达 $20,000 至 $35,000 以上。所有价格均包含 BC 建筑许可证、压力测试证书，以及从分水器到每个出水口的全屋冷热水管 PEX 更换。墙面修补和油漆另算。

规划厨房、浴室、全屋或商业装修？获取 Reno Stars 的免费、无义务报价。

Poly-B 管道会影响 BC 房屋保险吗？

直接影响。多家大型 BC 保险公司已更新承保准则，对配备 Poly-B 管道的房产拒绝或减少续保。完成认证 PEX 更换后，房屋通常能以标准费率恢复标准承保。BC 经纪人报告称，更换后每年的保费减免通常为 $800 至 $1,500，相当于每年收回更换成本的 5-10%。

BC 保险市场对 Poly-B 的态度仍然严格。现在完成更换意味着可按正常费率获得标准承保，消除转售时的买家顾虑，并消除在最糟糕时机发生灾难性漏水的风险。

Poly-B 更换需要多长时间？

公寓（单层、一个卫生间）：2-3 天。联排别墅（两层）：4-6 天。独立屋（两层、1,500-2,500 平方英尺）：5-7 天。豪华独立屋（三层、多套间）：10-14 天。BC 许可证在大温地区的审批时间目前为 1-3 周。

如何判断我家是否有 Poly-B 管道？

Poly-B 是灰白色塑料管，标注PB2110、Shell或Qest。如果您在 1985-1997 年间建成的大温哥华地区房屋从未进行过全屋管道更换，应假定存在 Poly-B，直至持牌水管工确认。在预约 Reno Stars 免费勘察时，可要求进行 Poly-B 评估。

常见问题

BC 房屋保险是否覆盖 Poly-B 更换？

BC 保险公司通常不承保预防性 Poly-B 更换。但完成带压力测试证书的认证更换后，大多数保险公司会以标准费率恢复标准承保。若房屋已发生 Poly-B 漏水导致损坏，保险索赔可能遭部分或全部拒绝。在漏水发生前完成全面更换是唯一确保保险连续性的方式。

我家有 Poly-B 管道，可以出售吗？

BC 要求卖方披露 Poly-B 管道的存在状况。买家常以此为谈判筹码压低房价 $10,000 至 $25,000。在挂牌前完成 PEX 更换可消除这一顾虑。

什么是 PEX 管道，为什么它是更换标准？

PEX（交联聚乙烯）是加拿大当前的住宅管道标准，已获 CSA B137.5 认证并在 BC 所有城市批准使用。厂家提供 25-50 年质保。

Poly-B 能否只做局部修复而不全换？

局部修复无法解决系统其余部分的整体老化问题。保险公司不会为部分修复的管道恢复承保。

Reno Stars 是否承接分层物业和公寓委员会的更换工程？

是的。Reno Stars 与分层管理委员会合作，规划和协调整栋楼的 Poly-B 更换项目，可将每户成本降低 15-25%。
